def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = max(set(grid[0]), key=grid[0].count)
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    def segments(n, cuts):
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    rs = segments(h, rows)
    cs = segments(w, cols)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != sep for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if count == 2 else 0)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    sep = max(colors, key=lambda x:
              sum(all(v == x for v in row) for row in grid) +
              sum(all(grid[r][c] == x for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    rcuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    ccuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    def spans(n, cuts):
        b = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(b[i] + 1, b[i + 1]) for i in range(len(b) - 1)]

    rs, cs = spans(h, rcuts), spans(w, ccuts)
    freq = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            if v != sep:
                freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(freq, key=freq.get)
    other = [x for x in freq if x != background]
    mark = max(other, key=freq.get) if other else background

    result = []
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        outrow = []
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            outrow.append(1 if n == 1 else background)
        result.append(outrow)
    return result
